name: go-web-starter
description: Generate modular Go, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and PostgreSQL websites with profiles, dashboards, an admin panel, user management, and private CRUD.

interface.longDescription: Build a full-stack website from a brief. Deliver a public landing page, accounts, private user profiles, personal dashboards, and an administrator panel for managing users, roles, and access. Register additional CRUD modules in a generated project using its command-line tool. Each module shares the Go REST API, React and TypeScript screens, Tailwind CSS, and PostgreSQL while isolating records by account and module. Includes migrations, Docker Compose, and tests.
defaultPrompt: Create a project tracker called Fieldbook with a landing page, accounts, and a private project dashboard.
Build a client portal with sign-up and a dashboard for creating, viewing, editing, and deleting clients.

prompts: Build a personal reading list called Shelf with email sign-in and private book records.
Create a client workspace called Studio Desk. Include an editable company name and contact email on each client.
Build a studio portal with clients and invoices, personal profiles, and an admin dashboard for managing accounts.

publication.release_notes: Added private profiles, user and administrator dashboards, account and role management, session revocation, and a resource registry and CLI for extending generated sites.
